case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your quotation and for explaining the electronic-component, copper and labour cost pressures. We recognise those pressures and your group's pricing constraints, while delivery reliability remains an important renewal issue.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3).

Our proposed longer commitment and annual demand visibility give you a concrete package to take through internal approval. We are flexible on payment terms, with the first option retaining your quoted terms; please choose whichever package works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 414.56 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 units per year.
Option B: EUR 415.73 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 units per year.

We value your defect-free quality and look forward to continuing our relationship with a concrete delivery-recovery plan.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Your remarks regarding delivery performance have been noted, and our logistics team will address this topic directly.

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month agreement, which provides valuable planning stability for both sides.

Our primary proposal is a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

In exchange for the extended contract duration, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €430.15 per unit while maintaining the 30-day payment terms. As an alternative, we offer a price of €430.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for revising your offer and confirming that logistics will address delivery reliability. We recognise your pricing restrictions and the planning value of a longer agreement, and we appreciate your consistently defect-free quality.

We have made a modest step in our proposal and hope you can reciprocate within the overall package. We are flexible on contract length: Option A retains the duration you welcomed, while Option B offers a longer planning horizon with the same annual demand visibility; please indicate which works best.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 423.53 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 45 days net, 4,580 units per year.
Option B: EUR 423.53 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 45 days net, 4,580 units per year.

We are close, and we would welcome agreement on Option A as a basis for continuing our valued partnership.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
